observations_paraphrased: The authors distinguish meson-exchange models from the underlying QCD account.
They identify pion exchange as a useful contribution to nucleon interactions rather than a complete elementary-force theory.
In the low-energy effective theory, the working degrees of freedom are nucleons and pions rather than quarks and gluons, with applicability constrained by that low-energy regime.
